mission: Plan B step 1 (owner 'OK, build plan B' 2026-11-04): owner confirmations of SNKRDUNK photos the collector's artwork check refused will be bound to the exact photo confirmed. New read runbook snkr-refused-photos reads, for every blocked SNKRDUNK refresh item refused by the artwork check, the page the collector stored at that refusal and runs the collector's own find_main_product_image on it (offline, no SNKRDUNK request). Also pins snkr_component to #262's merge (e9fd5f17), which released snkrdunk-collector.

impacts.reason: New read runbook: two SELECTs on the read-only session plus offline decoding and parsing of stored pages (snkr-page-check's decoder, the collector's extractor). No source request, no write.
Photo URL from the collector's main-image reading; no single main image reads as none; registration. 100 ops tests pass; the runbook SQL was executed against the Postgres 16 schema.
